tagline: Metal Gear Solid V, now with up to 16 players

milestones.download: Nothing to download yet. The first playable version, 0.1, is in development.
milestones.sessions: Sessions go live with version 0.1. Hosts will list their games here, and players join in one click.
milestones.mods: The mod list opens with the Mod API. You can already send a mod for review.

project.label: The project
project.title: Joint Operations
project.text: A multiplayer mod for Metal Gear Solid V: The Phantom Pain. The host runs the missions. Up to 15 clients share the session in the same open world.

team.label: The team
team.title: Hound Protocol
team.text: A community-focused organization. We build ambitious projects, one of them being Joint Operations. We run like Mother Base: Administration, Development, Quality and Contractors. Take a contract, deliver it, and earn your grade, from E to S++.
